final_manifest.status_rule: The manifest and all data remain review-pending until exact fragment commits and aggregate review are accepted.

identity_rules: Every fragment must identify the fixed input commit 542349e2f70ec9883d743594f906ac6c4e96ba5a and source boundary 1d6ee92adf6ccca38eeee64b1371cba1497e8fcd.
Every artifact path must resolve in the candidate and its SHA-256 must match the exact reviewed output commit.
Every source record must preserve repository-relative path, source commit, SHA-256, and exact line or line-range identity.
Every public API row must distinguish its canonical fully qualified public path from its actual definition owner and preserve cfg attributes and features.
Every package and manifest must retain a unique workspace identity; equal package names in separate workspaces remain separate records.
Every component WID must preserve its ID and name, actual definition source, task owner, and each public re-export path as a separate destination record.
Every historical row must preserve its original row identity and source bytes. It is a requirement or provenance record, not an active test.
Foundation package rows include package_id, manifest_path, normalized_package_identity, and metadata source identity; publisher packages with equal names remain distinct by workspace package ID.
Historical API rows separate source_api_identity, cleanup_attachment, and current_binding, and report explicit resolution status instead of inferring a current owner from a leaf symbol.

components.preservation: W01-W45 remain present without ID reuse. Add all required omitted component IDs from the accepted source fragment.

routes.preservation: Keep target tag, live Page object, dispatch path, factory, definition owner, and planned content owner separate. Each route carries a nested reference_source object bound to PR26 commit 5b3dbd7ae799f325efbb4f4cc11b2f5518dec948, with source path, registry line, hash, and optional factory line. Compare the full key set; 54 rows alone do not establish route coverage.
routes.owner_task_binding: Join route.requirement_id to the app-routes requirements array by id; preserve current route owner and planned content owner as separate fields.

reference_keyset.comparison: The final 54 reference_identity values must equal the complete key set extracted from the named PR26 source records at this exact commit; a count-only check is insufficient.
reference_keyset.check: Compute sorted keys from the fixed PR26 source bindings and the route index, reject missing, additional, or duplicate keys, and verify every nested reference_source path/hash/line against the pinned Git commit.

public_exports.source: all fragment export and item records
public_exports.preservation: Deduplicate only within the complete workspace/package/public-path/definition-owner key. Preserve equal package names from distinct workspaces, nested public paths, every distinct re-export destination, cfg alternatives, source and definition package identities, and exact source provenance.

input_fields.foundation: Every export and item retains workspace_id, package_id, normalized_package_identity, source_package_id, definition_package_id, canonical definition_owner, package-scoped public_qualified_paths/public_bindings, exact source path/line/hash, cfg attributes/features, and source provenance.
input_fields.components: Items retain package/manifest identity, qualified_symbol, definition_symbol, source, line_start, sha256, cfg alternatives, and reachability_paths; exports retain expanded_public_paths, expanded_symbols, and each exact edge chain with source locations.
input_fields.applications: Use exports.public_modules and exports.reexports for app-owned public paths; root-prefixed public modules/reexports remain under crates. Bind source_locations and enumerate public type, alias, constructor, builder, value, function, and re-export records with source identity, cfg, visibility, and canonical path.

requirements.source: all fragment requirements and history migration items
requirements.retire_rule: Every RETIRE requires a specific conflict or replacement and a matching independent decision bound to the source record and removal scope. For an API retirement, also bind the exact qualified public path and source API identity to the fixed product source, verify that exact removal scope is absent from fixed candidate 542349e2f70ec9883d743594f906ac6c4e96ba5a, and require the independent decision artifact to match the same symbol, source input, reviewer, artifact hash, and cleanup scope. A matching decision ID or absent index row alone is not sufficient.
requirements.unresolved_rule: Every unresolved row names a task and blocks final completion.

input_fields.foundation: requirements.id, named_owner_task, disposition, source, proposed_required_cases, evidence_state; historical_api_dispositions preserve source_api_identity, cleanup_attachment record/path/hash, current_binding, resolution status, and a specific conflict/replacement plus decision for RETIRE. API RETIRE rows also record exact candidate-542 absence and independently reviewed T37 decision binding.
input_fields.components: Requirements use requirement_id, named_owner_task, disposition, current_source, proposed_required_cases, and evidence; index every requirement and proposed case ID to its component WID and named task.
input_fields.applications: Requirements use id, task, source_refs, proposed_required_cases, case_status, and evidence; every route, API, requirement, and proposed case reference resolves to a declared record and named task.
input_fields.history: Migration items use item_id, historical_source, original_claim, current_sources, owner_task, disposition, disposition_reason, required_case, evidence, and block_final. Historical coverage rows use row_id and current_mapping. Validate each required_case, route association, owner task, and migration item reference against declared route/component/API/task indexes.

requirements.cross_link_rule: Normalize each fragment into declared requirement and case indexes. Every component, API, application, route, migration, and historical row requirement/case reference must resolve to an exact declared record; every requirement must name a valid owner task; reject dangling, duplicate, or undeclared IDs. Preserve source-specific IDs in the final index.

historical_coverage.rule: Validate every JSONL row, exact data hash, stable key, source identity, lane and disposition total. Do not copy all rows into requirements.json.

source_binding.historical_source: Commit, repository-relative path, physical line, raw line text, line SHA-256, full file SHA-256, and preserved T00 location.
source_binding.historical_claim: Original symbol/claim, reason, exact raw text, catalogue locator/span hash, and claim kind.
source_binding.join_key: Stable row_id. Preserve each original allowlist line, including duplicate source text at different line numbers.

policy_contract.keys_and_types: Preserve the six existing keys and their JSON types. Keep full API inventory detail in requirements.json.

ownership_compatibility.previous_proposal_rule: Preserve the original proposal owner values, source path, and hash inside requirements.json. Current component ownership fields name actual definition owners and keep re-exports separate.

migration_document_rule.claim_rule: All commit-pinned test links are historical. Do not describe removed tests or conformance targets as current.

required_historical_items.additional_application_and_review_decisi: All migration item records emitted by the accepted history fragment; keep each item ID distinct.

controls.mutation: Remove one Button/W02 canonical public path from a copied export index; keep the linked requirement disposition KEEP.
controls.expected: The validator reports that the required current public path is absent and exits nonzero.

controls.mutation: Change only the copied Button/W02 row to RETIRE without a matching source-bound independent decision.
controls.expected: The validator continues to reject the missing Button path.

controls.mutation: Attach the accepted runtime::stub T37 decision to Button/W02.
controls.expected: The validator rejects the mismatch between the decision's symbol/removal scope and Button.

controls.mutation: Change the copied runtime::stub row to KEEP although fixed candidate 542349e2f70ec9883d743594f906ac6c4e96ba5a has no current export. Preserve that product source 1d6ee92adf6ccca38eeee64b1371cba1497e8fcd did export runtime::stub before the accepted T37 removal.
controls.expected: The validator rejects the missing current export in fixed candidate 542. The historical product-source comparison still records the original 1d6 export; these source identities are not conflated.

controls.mutation: Restore the copied runtime::stub row to its exact source-bound RETIRE disposition and T37-FOUNDATION-TESTING-03 decision.
controls.expected: The validator discharges only the runtime::stub expectation after validating the exact T37 decision artifact hash, independent reviewer, source input, qualified symbol, removed re-export scope, and absence at fixed candidate 542.

decision_artifact.removal_scope: runtime::stub module and root re-export, as recorded in the reviewed T37 decision artifact

missing_export_control.mutation_scope: In-memory copies only. Keep product source, original migration rows, and all source-bound artifacts byte-identical.

checks: Verify each fragment commit and artifact SHA against the manifest.
Verify each source record against its exact Git commit, path, SHA-256, and line range.
Verify every WID, route identity, canonical public path, requirement identifier, and proposed case identifier appears exactly once in its declared index.
Verify definition owners and every re-export destination resolve to source-bound inventory rows with workspace/package identity and cfg alternatives.
Verify the exact 54-key route set against source-bound records from PR26 commit 5b3dbd7ae799f325efbb4f4cc11b2f5518dec948, including path, line, and file hash; do not accept a count-only match.
Verify every component, API, application, route, historical, migration, requirement, case, and named-owner cross-link resolves to its declared record.
Verify all required behavior cases are present as proposed/not-approved and remain NOT VERIFIED.
Verify all historical JSONL rows, lane/disposition totals, stable IDs, and source-row hashes.

Verify every RETIRE has a specific conflict/replacement and matching independent decision; for API RETIRE rows, also verify historical API identity, candidate-542 absence, removal scope, T37 artifact hash, source input, and independent reviewer.
Run the five accepted in-memory missing-export controls and record each expected/actual blocker.
limits: This checker validates static inventory data and source identities only.
No product source, tests, harnesses, fixtures, doctests, Cargo commands, or test plans are changed or executed.
Selected behavior cases remain zero; product behavior remains NOT VERIFIED.
The checker does not claim rustc-resolved feature reachability or prove behavior.

contract_review.scope: Aggregate schema, join/index contract, source-binding rules, disposition rules, and accepted in-memory negative-control specification only.
limits: This review does not accept any worker fragment or the final requirements.json.
This review does not approve a T38 plan or product behavior.
Selected behavior cases remain zero and product behavior remains NOT VERIFIED.
